scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:dao && pnpm run build:views
scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:dao && pnpm run test:views
scripts.coverage: pnpm run coverage:core && pnpm run coverage:dao && pnpm run coverage:views
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir core run lint && pnpm --dir dao run lint && pnpm --dir views run lint
scripts.type-check: pnpm run type-check:spec && pnpm --dir core run type-check && pnpm --dir dao run type-check && pnpm --dir views run type-check
scripts.clean: pnpm --dir core run clean && pnpm --dir dao run clean && pnpm --dir views run clean
scripts.spec: pnpm run build && pnpm run spec:generate
scripts.ci: pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
